computer-use-pill.description: The always-on-top pill shown while an agent uses an app: it only listens for what the agent is doing and calls Zorvo's own command that stops it. No dialogs, notifications, window dragging or other core APIs.

default.description: Permissions for the main window and per-session popout windows: core APIs, the title-bar drag region needed by the overlay traffic-light layout, the native open dialog used to pick folders and attachments, and system notifications when an agent needs the user or finishes.
